title: Maha Context Pack request
description: Compile task-specific, source-linked context. Source text and compiled context are processed transiently and not retained in the service ledger. Accepted by POST /api/context-packs and POST /api/v1/compress. Request limit: 450,000 bytes for x402 callers and standard API keys, 1,050,000 bytes for enterprise API keys. An x402 request is validated against this contract before its payment settles, so a rejected body is not charged.

tokenBudget.description: A model-neutral estimated-token budget; not a provider billing count.

id.description: Stable source ID, unique within the request.

text.description: No per-document character cap: the request is bounded by its byte limit.

provenance.description: Inline citation style in the rendered pack.
